quickAnswer: Liver Cirrhosis is the result of advanced Liver disease, characterized by replacement of liver tissues by fibrosis and regenerative nodules. In Omshree Sidha Hospital we have effective treatment for Liver cirrhosis and Fatty liver.
whatItMeans: Cirrhosis of the liver refers to scarring of the liver which results in abnormal liver function as a consequence of chronic liver injury. The causes of Liver Cirrhosis are Fatty liver, Hepatitis B and Hepatitis C, Alcoholism and other unknown reasons.
ayurvedicContext: Our Liver cirrhosis treatment consists of panchakarma plus internal and external medicine. We are using pure Ayurvedic medicines for the treatment of Liver Cirrhosis.
howTreatmentIsPlanned: In extreme severe cases (if the patient’s condition is not stable and requires regular fluid taping/removal) we will start with internal and external medicine, we can send it by courier/post. Normally we admit the patients and starts panchakarma and other medicines together. Duration of stay in the hospital depends upon how fast the patient is recovering.
whoShouldSeek: If you do the liver function test after 15 days you may understand that how fast you are improving. You can watch that how fast SGPT, SGOT, Bilirubin etc… getting normal
patientJourney: You may improve daily and normally within one to three months time you will be much better. If the patients come before starting the fluid retention, the speed of recovery will be faster.
